items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:68:1
items.html: The first Hey of the general HaVaYaH, etc., is the whole name SAG one, etc.: He explains here how YESHSUT, the aforementioned one Tevuna, which comes out from the posterior of the Malchut of Upper Bina, and clothes the upper AVI from their Chazeh downward — who are the level of AB, the first Yod of the general HaVaYaH — while YESHSUT are the HaVaYaH of SAG, and are the first Hey of the HaVaYaH, and are the level of SAG. And he explains here the five Partzufim in this Partzuf, and how the NHY of every upper Partzuf, from the discernment of its externality, namely from its posterior as above, is found clothing in the lower one and becoming for it face and internality.
